name: thomast8-claude-plugins
description: Thomas Tiotto's Claude Code plugins, bundled into a single marketplace. One `/plugin marketplace add` command gives you access to all of them.

plugins.name: worktree-toolkit
plugins.description: Create git worktrees from PR numbers / branch names / a live picker (your open PRs and PRs needing your review), and reclaim worktree branches back into main. Graphite-aware. Bundles WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks so the session's project directory follows the worktree.

plugins.name: find-reviewer
plugins.description: `/find-reviewer` ranks contributors by load, breadth across the repo, and familiarity with the changed files. Auto-detects the current branch's PR. Cached.

plugins.name: claude-code-caffeinate
plugins.description: Keep your Mac awake only while Claude Code is actively processing, with a SwiftBar menu bar dashboard showing per-session activity and token usage.

plugins.name: session-title
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that renames each Claude Code session on its first prompt by asking Haiku for a kebab-case summary. One-shot per session, recursion-safe, slugified-prompt fallback.
